scripts.//// Neoffice: commit-the-build: the SPA the CI builds is committed in suite/public/frontend (build-frontend.yml), so a plain `yarn build` must NOT rebuild it on an instance. Frappe's esbuild runs it after the desk bundle of every `bench build --app suite`: on a 2 vCPU / 4 GB client its Vite build took 1.6 GB and stalled the machine on memory (67 % pressure, the database pushed into swap) at every update, then failed and was thrown away. FORCE_REBUILD=1 forces it; upstream's command is kept verbatim as build:force.
scripts.build: if [ -d 'suite/public/frontend/assets' ] && [ -z "$FORCE_REBUILD" ]; then echo '[skip-build] pre-built artifacts present at suite/public/frontend/assets (set FORCE_REBUILD=1 to force rebuild)'; else yarn build:force; fi
